---
name: Phone report
about: Tell us how ROS2 Android works on your phone, good or bad
title: "Phone report: <manufacturer model>, Android <version>"
---

**Phone**
Manufacturer and model, Android version (Settings → About phone). No serial number.

**ROS2 Android version**
App version (Settings → About in the app) and how you installed it (APK, `.deb`, source).

**What you tried**
- [ ] Sensors publishing to a PC
- [ ] Dashboard controls or camera images
- [ ] A deployed workspace (Projects)
- [ ] ESP32 over USB or Wi-Fi, or flashing through the phone
- [ ] Running without a PC

**What worked and what didn't**
Include anything Android paused or stopped, and which battery/background settings you
changed. If you ran the [qualification batch](../../docs/PHONE-QUALIFICATION.md), attach
its `summary.json` only.

Please leave out personal data: no serial numbers, IP addresses, photos or raw phone logs.
